66b38c7bf85b8bf7250f9cb7.g: The heavily mined area refers to the west and north-west approaches to the "USEC camp" which is located in the northwest. The safest way to fulfill the objective is to get inside the camp from the north, east or south and walk up to the sandbags between the big rocks in the west of the camp that block off a path to the mines.
